text_block_list.text:
Running through the seemingly endless 
1,600 meters of the Mile CS, Sakura 
Bakushin O clinched the victory!

Sakura Bakushin O's heart was completely 
filled with pride over her own 
extraordinary talent and potential.

However, her challenge continues! Until 
she conquers the Bakushin Road— Bakushin, 
Bakushin!
